Permission

Reviewed before it goes public.

How this works

  • A photographer or moderator on the site team looks at every upload.
  • We approve anything school-appropriate that shows the class in a good light. Blurry is fine. Mean is not.
  • Approved photos appear on the photos page with your credit. Rejected ones are deleted, not stored.
  • Anyone in a photo can ask for it to come down, no reason needed. Use the contact form.
